title: Unique and sturdy!
text: Unique and sturdy!. This is absolutely perfect! We're using it as an entry table. The unit arrived fully assembled and the quality is very good. I included a photo of it in real life. :-) It's a nice break from all the furniture we've had to assemble! It was a huge plus that this was on sale.

product_metadata.title: Powell Company 990-333 Parcel 13-Drawer Cabinet Distressed White, 13.75 X 23.8 X 31.88
features: The cabinet has a vintage, industrial flair
Will add character and interest to your space
Thirteen drawers provide ample storage space
description: The Parcel Cabinet will add vintage character and interest to any area of your home. The cabinet has a distressed white frame and multicolored distressed drawer fronts that give the piece a vintage, industrial flair. Each drawer is accented with an antiqued styled pull. Thirteen multi-sized drawers provide ample storage space for a variety of items. Perfect for an entry, hobby room or bedroom.
